6626.header: The Route 92 will operate on Detour as the result of Construction at the Fall Creek Dr. and Stewart
6626.message: The Route 92 will operate on Detour as the result of Construction at the Fall Creek Dr. and Stewart Ave intersection. Beginning May 4th until mid-November 2026. From West Ave. the detour will bypass Stewart Ave and take University Ave. to Thurston Ave.

7014.message: Starting Monday 5/18/26 Route 10s will start using Tioga Street. Temporary bus Stop for Seneca Street will be relocated to Tioga @ Buffalo.
